consumer: The frontend map view that reads the snapshot's per-tile ter/furn ids and renders them as the displayed terrain/furniture for nearby tiles; it asks 'what symbol/appearance do I SHOW for this tile?'
scope: the nearby exported tile window around the view center (a local map region), as the GUI would display it
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (per tile) writes ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() and ctx.m.furn(p).id().str() into the snapshot JSON, consumed purely to draw the map view
divergence: A tile the player previously saw but can no longer see whose terrain/furniture changed off-screen (e.g. a door smashed open out of view): the GUI map should show the remembered/last-seen appearance, so reading raw current ter()/furn() would display state the player has no displayed knowledge of, exposing a wrong display-layer answer
